# Review engineering package

- Perform a read-only review of the assigned engineering package.
- Inspect the git diff, PROJECT_MANIFEST.md, CURRENT_STATUS.md, ROADMAP.md, and the relevant source and test files.
- Check architecture boundaries, domain rules, typing, test coverage, duplication, and scope.
- Do not modify files during review.
- Produce findings ordered by severity, including clear recommendations.
- Reference the Project Intelligence documents when assessing whether the package remains aligned with the project's current plan.
